name: Push / Pull / Legs - 3 days
description: DEFAULT. Each muscle trained hard once per week with some overlap (shoulders/triceps on push, biceps/rear delts on pull). 12 weeks + deload + re-test.
targetUser: Beginner, body recomposition, 45-60 min sessions, UG Legon campus gym equipment only
schedulingNotes: App tracks the NEXT day in the rotation, not weekdays. Missing a day never skips a workout. Recommend >= 1 rest day between sessions when possible (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Sat).

progressionDefaults.successRule: all working sets reach repRange.max with reported RIR >= target RIR - 1 (i.e. not grinding harder than planned)
progressionDefaults.onSuccess: increase load by weightIncrementKg next session (2x increment if every set hit max+2 reps at RIR >= target+1)
progressionDefaults.onPartial: keep load; aim for +1 rep on the weakest set
progressionDefaults.stallDefinition: no increase in total reps or load vs. the last exposure of the same exercise
progressionDefaults.tooHeavyRule: if first set reps < repRange.min - 2, drop load by one increment immediately for the remaining sets
progressionDefaults.smallIncrementGuard: if increment > 10% of current load, extend the rep target to repRange.max + up to 3 reps before adding weight

missedTrainingRules.daysOff_over_21: -20% load, RIR 4, re-run find-weight on primaries

equipmentAssumptions.noRack: No squat rack / bench uprights listed: barbell squat & bench default to Smith machine. Barbell lifts used are floor-started (RDL, bent-over row).
equipmentAssumptions.ankleMachine: Ambiguous - not used in any default. Onboarding asks: ankle-strap cable attachment / calf machine / hip machine / unknown. If ankle strap: unlocks cable_standing_leg_curl, cable_kickback. If calf machine: machine_calf_raise replaces leg_press_calf_raise.

phases.name: Phase 1 - Foundation
phases.goal: Learn every machine and movement, set safe starting weights, build the habit. Machines + dumbbells only.

days.name: Push (chest, shoulders, triceps)

items.notes: Easy pace (RPE 3-4, can talk in full sentences). Alternative: incline_treadmill_walk 3-5% incline. In the heat keep it EASY - the goal is warm, not sweaty-exhausted.
10 forward + 10 backward, small to big circles.
Hands on a bench, slow and controlled; warms chest/shoulders/triceps.
Very light (1-2 plates), 15 reps, squeeze shoulder blades. Primes shoulders for pressing.
Seat so handles line up with mid-chest. Shoulder blades back, feet flat. 2 s down, controlled push.
Handles start around chin/shoulder height. Don't arch the lower back off the pad.
Bench at ~30 degrees (2nd-3rd notch). Kick DBs up from the knees; lower to upper chest.
Light! Raise out to the side to shoulder height, slight bend in elbows, no swinging.
Rope or bar. Elbows pinned to your sides; only forearms move.
Zone 2 (talk test: can speak in sentences, not sing). Treadmill 4.5-5.5 km/h at 5-10% incline, hold rails only for balance. At 95 kg this is far kinder to knees than jogging.
Slow walk / easy pedal until breathing settles; drink water.
Optional: 2-3 stretches for today's muscles, ~30 s each, gentle. Stretching is for comfort/mobility, not required for growth.

name: Upper / Lower - 2 days
description: Recommended fallback when the 3-week rolling average is < 2.5 sessions/week.
targetUser: Beginner, body recomposition, 45-60 min sessions, UG Legon campus gym equipment only
schedulingNotes: App tracks the NEXT day in the rotation, not weekdays. Missing a day never skips a workout. Recommend >= 1 rest day between sessions when possible (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri or Tue/Thu/Sat).

progressionDefaults.successRule: all working sets reach repRange.max with reported RIR >= target RIR - 1 (i.e. not grinding harder than planned)
progressionDefaults.onSuccess: increase load by weightIncrementKg next session (2x increment if every set hit max+2 reps at RIR >= target+1)
progressionDefaults.onPartial: keep load; aim for +1 rep on the weakest set
progressionDefaults.stallDefinition: no increase in total reps or load vs. the last exposure of the same exercise
progressionDefaults.tooHeavyRule: if first set reps < repRange.min - 2, drop load by one increment immediately for the remaining sets
progressionDefaults.smallIncrementGuard: if increment > 10% of current load, extend the rep target to repRange.max + up to 3 reps before adding weight

missedTrainingRules.daysOff_over_21: -20% load, RIR 4, re-run find-weight on primaries
